title: Rabbi Acha son of R' Ba bar Mamal
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat, chapter 6, halakhah 6; Hyman calls this a scribal error and says the reading should be “Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Ba bar Mamal,” as in the Krotoschin printing.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:6 has Acha reporting Ba bar Mamal, supporting the transmission interpretation. Hyman’s report of the Krotoschin printing is not independently verified by this digital witness.

The whole Guggenheimer Shabbat 6:6 paragraph fully writes Rabbi Acha in the name of Rabbi Ba bar Mamal. The proposed reporting chain has local full-title support; the son-of heading retains R' before Ba without treating the reporting authority as a proved father. Hyman’s scribal-error judgment and “should read” retain their force. His Krotoschin report and the existing note remain; the printed edition was not freshly collated.
